notes:
Lead: Indigo Sparrow is a mid-market analytics SaaS (product analytics / in-app insights). They've been on a 30-day Hosted API trial; now moving toward Dedicated evaluation.

POC summary / ask: mostly chat + doc-search reranking. Trial workload: ~25k API calls/day (mixed chat & embeddings). They want a Dedicated pool that keeps 99th p50 latency under 300ms for short chat turns and p95 < 1s for typical flows. Cost-conscious but willing to commit for predictable latency.

Traffic & capacity details (from trial + customer forecast):
- Current trial (hosted): 25k req/day, avg tokens per request (chat) ~520 (prompt ~420 / completion ~100). Embeddings requests are ~12% of calls but heavier on QPS bursts.
- Observed token/day (trial): ~13M tokens/day (mix: ~78% chat, ~12% embeddings, ~10% rerank/batch).
- Customer forecast (12mo): expect 8x growth in usage if Dedicated reduces latency/cost — target steady state ~200k req/day.
- QPS/concurrency targets for Dedicated sizing: sustained QPS 12-18, expected baseline concurrency ~40, peak bursts up to 60-80 concurrent workers during product events.
technical_findings: Latency: hosted p50 ~180ms for short prompts, p95 ~900ms under burst — caching could reduce tail
Token mix: ~78% chat (avg 520 tokens), ~12% embeddings (short text -> 512 tokens avg), ~10% reranking (batch calls up to 2k tokens)
Throughput: current Hosted API throttling hit during midnight ET batch jobs — customer will move batch rerank to off-peak or Dedicated batching
Reliability: wants automatic fallback to hosted model variants during infra events
Security: strict need for audit logs & KMS; regional data residency for EU customers (subset of customers hosted in eu-1 region)
dedicated_sizing_notes: Initial ask: 2x GPU nodes (A100-equivalent) with autoscale + burst pool; target headroom for 2x peak concurrency
Suggested config: 3 cards (reserve) with burst to 5 during weekly spikes; recommend prefix KV cache for chat to cut token spend by ~18%
Batching plan: run embeddings rerank jobs on scheduled windows to smooth QPS
Cost estimate shared: preliminary ARR delta based on committed capacity presented in sizing deck (linked)
commercial_notes: Pricing: finance asks for committed monthly price for Dedicated (12mo) to compare against open usage on hosted — aim to reduce token unit cost by ~30%
Contract preference: monthly billing with 6 month trial to validate cost economics
Upsell path: Redwood Optimize (model + quantization recommendations) discussed to further lower unit cost
